title: Stackelberg Self-Annotation: A Robust Approach to Data-Efficient LLM Alignment

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model robustness against preference noise by deliberately flipping preferred/unpreferred labels on 25% of the seed data pairs and measuring the resulting performance degradation, as well as mitigating systematic biases in synthetic self-annotated labels via a distributionally robust Stackelberg game framework.

Comparing standard win rates against length-controlled (LC) win rates using the AlpacaEval 2.0 benchmark, which employs a regression model to neutralize the known tendency of evaluators to prefer longer LLM responses.
